name: The Restless Dead

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Hall of Thanes holds your people's honored dead and ancestors. Their sudden and violent stirring unsettles the heart of dwarven heritage.
As a priest, you are called to commune with souls and guide troubled dead toward peaceful rest when spirits linger in torment or anger.
As an Alliance member, you help secure the ancestral crypts beneath Ironforge so the keepers can carry out their sacred duties without fear of vengeful apparitions.

faq.answer: An unknown disturbance has stirred the spirits in the crypts beneath the Hall of Thanes. The keepers fear to enter while the apparitions remain agitated.
faq.q: What is The Restless Dead quest about?

faq.answer: An unknown disturbance in the deep vaults woke the entombed dead. The spirits in the Hall of Thanes are light sleepers, and whatever happened in the tombs roused them to rage and torment.
The disturbance lies in the crypts and vaults beneath Ironforge's Hall of Thanes, an ancestral resting place where ancient dwarven spirits lie entombed.
faq.q: Where does this disturbance take place?

faq.answer: Anvilmar is an ancient and prominent spirit resting in the deep tombs of the Hall of Thanes. This great spirit awakened alongside lesser apparitions and must return to peaceful rest.
faq.q: Who is the spirit of Anvilmar?

faq.answer: The keepers care for the crypts and perform their regular duties in the Hall of Thanes. Angry spirits roam the halls, so the keepers refuse to enter the lower vaults until the danger passes.
faq.q: Why do the keepers need an adventurer's help?

aliases: what kinds of ghosts are down there
faq.answer: Enraged Apparitions, Tormented Souls, and the great spirit of Anvilmar haunt the disturbed vaults. All were startled into an aggressive vigil within the burial chambers.
faq.q: What spirits haunt the Hall of Thanes?

sections.body: Generations of honored dwarves rest in the ancestral crypts beneath the Hall of Thanes. Their spirits usually sleep in peace, but something unseen has stirred them violently. Strange noises rise from the lower vaults and frighten the caretakers. They will not enter those chambers or perform their duties until order returns. Now adventurers are called to quiet the agitated souls.
sections.title: Disturbance in the Deep Vaults

sections.body: The spirits in the Hall of Thanes are light sleepers. Whatever disturbed the lower tombs roused Enraged Apparitions and Tormented Souls, turning sacred ground into a perilous haunt. The revered spirit of Anvilmar has awakened as well. A respectful but firm hand must quell the ancestors' fury and restore peace to the catacombs.
sections.title: Quieting the Ancestors

summary: Beneath the Hall of Thanes, restless spirits trouble the crypts where generations of dwarven dead lie at rest. The caretakers fear to enter the vaults, and the disturbance has reached the spirit of Anvilmar.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Restless Dead
